hook: An AI agent should never be allowed to approve its own side effect.
thesis: The model suggests, the machine decides. No model output ever flips its own effect to authorized. This is the authorization boundary at the heart of TenantOS: fast typed judgment from a model feeds triage, while the deterministic kernel holds the sole authority to approve effects.
